about: The support assistant's trust boundaries, as Module 1 maps them. A source is trusted only if the shop controls what it says. Everything else is data: the model reads it, but it must never be obeyed. The tools list what each tool can reach in the weak start, before any control.

sources.name: team member's request
sources.enters_as: the start of the user message

sources.name: ticket text
sources.from: the customer: anyone who can send a message

sources.name: help document
sources.from: shop staff and suppliers (one supplier passage hides an instruction)

sources.name: order record
sources.from: the shop database, with notes typed by customers and couriers

search_docs.reaches: every help document of both shops, staff-only ones too

read_file.reaches: any file under the file area, and a ../ path leaves it (the server's config with a secret)

fetch_url.reaches: any web address, the cloud metadata address and the server's own admin page too
fetch_url.asset: the cloud credentials on the metadata page

create_return_label.changes: a paid return label is made

send_email.asset: customers' data and the shop's name
